title: 亡灵契约师部分重做
description:
亡灵契约师部分重做

围绕灾厄、自身灾厄与奥斯提，对《杀戮尖塔 2》的亡灵契约师进行部分重做。与原版同名的卡牌直接修改原牌，不额外添加同名副本。

主要改动：
- 多张原版卡牌及其后续能力给予的灾厄提高至原始数值的1.5倍，施加者额外获得原始数值三分之一的灾厄，均向下取整。精神过载、Death、Underworld及其后续能力保留原版效果，不放大，也不额外反噬。
- 多目标牌每次打出只结算一次自身反噬；反噬本身不会再次被放大。
- 重做灾厄之衣、负能量脉冲、荒疫打击；死神形态额外使你不会因灾厄死亡。
- 新增十张卡牌：死生契阔、负能量吸收、共赴黄泉、此恨绵绵、血誓、黑暗仪式、饮鸩、借尸还魂、灵魂虚影、同仇敌忾。灵魂虚影在常规卡池中替代纠缠。
- 包含中文与英文本地化及新增美术。

需要 STS2 RitsuLib 0.6.15 或更新版本。包含游戏0.111与0.113的独立兼容实现。
本 Mod 与 Black Souls Ancients 独立，不需要订阅后者。
部分新增美术使用 AI 生成素材。

Necrobinder: Partial Rework

A partial rework of the Necrobinder for Slay the Spire 2, focused on Doom, self-inflicted Doom, and Osty. Changes to existing cards replace their original effects rather than adding duplicate cards.

Main changes:
- Several vanilla cards and their ongoing powers apply 150% of their original Doom. The applier also receives Doom equal to one third of the original amount. Both values are rounded down. Neurosurge, Death, and Underworld, including their ongoing powers, keep their vanilla effects without amplification or additional self-inflicted Doom.
- Area cards apply this additional self-inflicted Doom once per play, not once per enemy. This additional Doom is not amplified again.
- Reworks Shroud, Negative Pulse, and Blight Strike. Reaper Form also prevents death from Doom.
- Adds ten cards: Death and Life's Pact, Negative Energy Absorption, Together Unto Death, Endless Hatred, Blood Oath, Dark Ritual, Poisoned Draught, Borrowed Body, Soul Phantom, and Shared Vengeance. Soul Phantom replaces Haunt in the normal card pool.
- Includes Chinese and English localization and new artwork.

Requires STS2 RitsuLib 0.6.15 or later. Includes separate implementations for game versions 0.111 and 0.113.
This is a standalone mod and does not require Black Souls Ancients.
Some new artwork uses AI-generated assets.

同时支持0.111.x,0.113.x
changeNote:
0.1.3
- 新增血誓、黑暗仪式、饮鸩、借尸还魂、灵魂虚影、同仇敌忾，接入审核后的美术。
- 荒疫打击：9（12）点基础伤害，加自身灾厄的一半，向下取整；实时预览。
- 负能量吸收改为普通卡，只吸收指定一名敌人的一半灾厄。
- 共赴黄泉改为0费、不消耗，升级后本回合不会因灾厄死亡。
- 借尸还魂额外获得1层无实体；灵魂虚影替代常规卡池中的纠缠，不再自动使灵魂获得虚无。
- 精神过载、Death、Underworld及其后续能力不再参与灾厄放大和反噬；死神形态额外防止灾厄死亡。
- 更新中英文文本与说明。

Added Blood Oath, Dark Ritual, Poisoned Draught, Borrowed Body, Soul Phantom, and Shared Vengeance, with approved artwork. Blight Strike now deals 9 (12) plus half your Doom, rounded down. Negative Energy Absorption is Common and targets one enemy. Together Unto Death costs 0, no longer Exhausts, and prevents death from Doom this turn when upgraded. Borrowed Body also grants 1 Intangible. Soul Phantom replaces Haunt without automatically granting Souls Ethereal. Neurosurge, Death, and Underworld keep vanilla Doom behavior. Reaper Form also prevents death from Doom. Updated Chinese and English text.

两套兼容实现编译通过，198项自动测试通过。未替代游戏内、双端联机及匹配0.111本体的实测。
Both compatibility builds and 198 automated tests pass. In-game, multiplayer, and matching-runtime 0.111 playtests remain outstanding.
